site_name: Triangle Development Site Situated Adjacent To Paddington Station
description: Amendments to planning permission dated 2nd April 2015 (RN:12/07668/FULL) for Development of an office building comprising canal-side reception with 21 storeys of offices and either Class A1/A2/A3 use at canal-side and first floor level, alongside pedestrian linkages to Paddington Station and Bishop's Bridge Road, in conjunction with landscaping and other associated works. Namely, rationalisation of the southern structural transfer expression; rationalisation of the canal side structural transfer expression to match the structural grid; reconfiguration of the east and central core, including: addition of a dedicated fire-fighting lift, addition of a combined passenger/evacuation lift and a passenger/goods lift that now serve the basement levels, and enlargement and relocation of the accessible WC from the eastern to the central core; external alterations to the western lift shaft façade, reducing the extent of glazing; the material treatment of the stair and lift cores changed from aluminium cladding to concrete; 500mm extension of the north office façade; replacement of the brise soleil (fins) with deeply expressed mullion system; external terraces reconfigured; Internal layout reconfiguration; and adjustment of the Building Maintenance Unit (BMU) layout at roof level.
